title: Karen, an experiencer who threw lamps at the beings

tellings.quote: Karen, one of the they used to throw things at them. I mean, she'd throw lamps.

plain: A woman named Karen, one of the people who said they had been visited by non-human beings, used to fight back by throwing things at them, even lamps. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells this from his time around John Mack, a Harvard psychiatrist who studied people reporting alien abductions, as a sign that not everyone took these encounters quietly.
